premise.claim: 0.9.0 needs a migration window: 'existing deprecated workload roles remain reconcilable, while new deprecated workload uses are rejected' plus an admission warning on every v1alpha1 write. On base, with the default flag, a NEW deprecated workload use is admitted silently and no v1alpha1 admission webhook exists.
premise.reportedComponent: admission validation layer (v1alpha2 validators + v1alpha1 webhooks)
premise.evidence: round 1: base's own test asserts 'deprecated workload types enabled, StatefulSet - no error' (results/premise-base.txt); api/workloads/v1alpha1/ on base 885d655 contains zero webhook markers. round 2: base moved to a2e797c6 (#514, test/e2e infra + vendor only — no api/, config/, cmd/, internal/, pkg/ files), so the premise evidence carries over verbatim; re-confirmed zero kubebuilder:webhook markers in api/workloads/v1alpha1/ on a2e797c6.

integration.cmd: D="${GINKGO_REPORT%/*}"; export KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS="${KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS:-$HOME/.local/share/kubebuilder-envtest/k8s/1.31.0-linux-amd64}" ; go test -count=1 ./test/envtest/testcase/deprecationv1a1/... -ginkgo.json-report="$D/r-deprecationv1a1.json" && go test -count=1 ./test/envtest/testcase/deprecationv1a1outage/... -ginkgo.json-report="$D/r-outage.json" && go test -count=1 ./test/envtest/testcase/deprecationv1a1spoof/... -ginkgo.json-report="$D/r-spoof.json" && go test -count=1 ./test/envtest/testcase/deprecationv1a1conversion/... -ginkgo.json-report="$D/r-conversion.json"; rc=$?; jq -s 'add' "$D/r-deprecationv1a1.json" "$D/r-outage.json" "$D/r-spoof.json" "$D/r-conversion.json" > "$GINKGO_REPORT"; exit $rc

findings.note: Round 3: advisory C4431130427 claimed the contract suite ran version-only conversion (schemes registered after TestEnv.Start). c875fb31 registers both workload versions before Start. These specs prove the fix: the rolebasedgroups CRD installed by envtest must carry a Webhook conversion strategy, and a v1alpha1 create must be stored through the production v1alpha2 conversion. Bite check: reverting the registration order makes both specs fail (results/bite-conversion-order.txt).

stores a v1alpha1 create through the production v1alpha2 conversion
